title: I made my first million at 19 years old, here's how..
summary: A dropshipper recounts going from YouTube and digital products to a million-dollar store by 19 after early losses; pitches his mentorship.

assertions.quote: I was a normal kid playing video games. and I found a hobby and turned it into a way to make money
99% of those people you guys see online selling a course or mentorship don't actually drop ship. They're making money from you off their course
drop shipping is going to be this super fast get-rich quick like I'm going to be at 10k days tomorrow
my very first two months of drop shipping, I was down $8,000
I ended up redesigning the website, fully branding it, and also changing my offer
with a digital product, it's super high margins
The product ended up being very defective. So, I just shut down the store.
My YouTube channel gone. My Tik Tok account gone.
